chronic.definition: Long-standing, generally present for more than three months.
chronic.example: It has become a chronic problem, so I have started to manage it differently.

dual_deliberation.definition: The short space in which one argument is weighed against another.
dual_deliberation.example: Deliberation took two minutes, and the two minutes were enough.

garden.definition: A piece of ground where people grow plants and flowers. A garden needs water and a little care every day.
garden.example: The green door opened on a garden under a round moon.

grit.definition: Sustained effort toward long-term goals, maintained through boredom and setbacks.

play_together.definition: To do the same game with another child, side by side. It is the simplest friendship there is.
play_together.example: We play together at break time every day.

si_velocity.definition: The speed of a body together with its direction.
